notes: Envelope from the en-gb DualSense Edge buy-now page's «Product Specifications» (canonical URL confirmed as the Edge page), labelled «Approx. H66 x W160 x D106 mm» — the same figure Sony prints for the DualSense; the page does not say whether projections are excluded, so excludes_projections is null. Mass from the CFI-ZCP1 instruction manual (playstation.com PDF, AES-encrypted, text extracted with PDFKit): «Mass Approx. 325 g» (the controller; the stick module is listed separately at 15 g with its own «Approx. 30 × 31 × 40mm (width × height × depth)»). The buy page's «Approx. 0.3kg» is the same mass rounded. Controls from the manual's «Part names» (front, top, rear; PDF lines joined with single spaces in the quotes): dpad 1; face_button 4 (action buttons); bumper 2 (R1/L1) and trigger 2 (R2/L2, with stop sliders, which have no contract kind); stick 2 (changeable modules and caps; R3/L3 clicks); button 6 = create, options, PS, mute and two Fn buttons (the front diagram labels I twice; Sony's page says «Function buttons»); touchpad 1; rear_button 2 = the two back-button slots (each takes a half-dome or a lever back button; two of each ship). rear_button is not in the controller contract's list; it is the slab-handheld kind, used here and for the Switch 2 Pro GL/GR so builders read one name. The pin-hole reset button is not counted. Ports (manual: «USB port», «Headset jack»): usb_c, because Sony Japan's page lists the bundled cable as «USB 編み込みケーブル（Type-C）» (its controller end is Type-C; the release does not name the port type), and headphone_3_5 by the catalog convention (no diameter printed). The connector housing that locks the cable is an accessory. host_console uses the key sony-playstation-5-cfi-1000 (the launch model; any PS5 model hosts it). wired=false: USB cable or Bluetooth.
